hero.eyebrowTag: Open-source OpenCode V2 gateway for vibecoders
hero.headline: Every AI Coding Pass. One Terminal Cockpit.
hero.subheadline: Routes tasks across a 3-slot ModelSlotChain inside OpenCode V2 today, with Stage 3 Hivemind-Substrate roadmap previewing The Spine, The Honeycomb, and Working-Set Valve.
hero.philosophySummary: Stop paying $200/month across five isolated coding apps. Hivemind Steward is the free open-source OpenCode V2 gateway that centralizes your Devin, Antigravity, Freebuff, and GLM coding passes in one terminal.
hero.installLabel: Install the free OpenCode V2 gateway in one command
hero.reactorStageHint: Select any node (devin, antigravity, freebuff, or substrate) to inspect live model IDs, ACP wire frames, and release status.

horizons.sectionSubtitle: See what runs in your terminal right now, what lands next in the multi-pass gateway, and what is queued in the lightweight Stage 3 memory skeleton.
horizons.shippedDescription: Live /devin hosted view in OpenCode V2, native delegate-devin child sessions (ses_*), crash-safe session recovery, interactive permission checks, and the npx hmoc-steward-acp installer.
horizons.nextReleaseDescription: Unified acp-session-core.ts, hosted views for /devin and /antigravity, source-tagged / and @ autocomplete, live ctrl+m/ctrl+e/ctrl+t switching, 3-slot ModelSlotChain, and affordable freebuff-native passes (deepseek-4.1-flash and glm-5.3-flash).
horizons.roadmapDescription: Upcoming companion skeleton keeping long coding sessions lean: The Spine (.session-archive/blobs/<sha256>.txt and shadow Git checkpoints), The Honeycomb (index.sqlite with AST and RepoMap), and Working-Set Valve (sub-2ms context pruning).

xrayExplorer.sectionSubtitle: Every sub-2-minute workflow clip opens its exact terminal prompt, JSON-RPC tool call, and raw engine response.

greenfieldSection.sectionSubtitle: Watch Freebuff (deepseek-4.1-flash and glm-5.3-flash), Devin (swe-2-max), and Antigravity (argon-4-high) ship this portal across 5 verified slices (V1 to V5) without blowing frontier token budgets.
greenfieldSection.verificationBadge: Verified gate: bun test + bun run typecheck + bun run build

substrateSection.sectionSubtitle: A lightweight three-part memory skeleton on our roadmap designed to stop context bloat and keep multi-pass coding sessions sharp.
substrateSection.spineSubtitle: Content-addressed session archive and shadow Git snapshots
substrateSection.spineDescription: Saves raw tool outputs into .session-archive/blobs/<sha256>.txt alongside working-tree Git snapshots before context compaction runs.
substrateSection.honeycombSubtitle: Local SQLite search index with AST symbols and RepoMap
substrateSection.honeycombDescription: Indexes session decisions, AST symbol skeletons, PageRank RepoMap, and git_cochange history in index.sqlite for fast local lookup.
substrateSection.valveSubtitle: Fast pre-turn log pruning and compact handoff packets
substrateSection.valveDescription: Swaps stale 40KB tool dumps for lightweight sha256 pointers in under 2ms and keeps session handoff packets under 1,200 tokens.

conversionSection.sectionSubtitle: Hivemind Steward is 100% free and open-source. Vibecoders pair it with affordable Freebuff and Zap GLM coding passes to cut monthly AI spend, while AI providers sponsor our GitHub, YouTube, Reddit, and Discord showcases to reach active terminal builders.
conversionSection.calculatorSubtitle: Estimate how much you save each month by routing repo recon and fast edits to Freebuff and Zap GLM passes instead of burning $200/month frontier quotas.
conversionSection.optimizedCostLabel: Steward gateway with Freebuff + GLM passes

episodesSection.pageSubtitle: Watch sub-2-minute workflow clips and the 5-minute multi-pass build with side-by-side bilingual transcripts and raw OpenCode V2 terminal traces.
